The '''1988–89 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 58th since its establishment. It began on 3 September 1988, and concluded on 25 June 1989.

[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] finished the season as champions for the fourth year running, while [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] recovered under new coach [[Johan Cruyff]] to finish second.
